description_en: Deletes the remediation settings for a rule in a specified account group
description_zh: 删除指定账号组规则的修正设置
kebab_example: aliyun config delete-aggregate-remediations --remediation-ids crr-909ba2d4716700eb0000 --aggregator-id ca-6b4a626622af00120000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAggregateRemediations

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the remediation setting. Separate multiple remediation setting IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a remediation setting, see [ListAggregateRemediations](~~270036~~).
parameters.description_zh:
修正设置ID。多个修正设置ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取修正设置ID，请参见[ListAggregateRemediations](~~270036~~)。
